decisions.reason: Turnaround management software sits at the core of the integrated airside offer, has its own page and remains a promising option that is cheap to hold.
The connectivity module is a low-cost software add-on to the installed base, and two years is still too short to resolve its value in long airport sales cycles.
Billing software is further from the operational core and gives only weak signals, but its maintenance cost is low and airport procurement is slow, so the option is kept for now.
Resource management complements turnaround software in an integrated suite, so its option value stays high while the cost of holding it is small.
The safety alert service extends the tower and traffic control offer, where certification and procurement take years, so its value cannot yet be judged and keeping it is justified.
